question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region_name,
        sr.name as sales_rep_name,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_total_sales
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name
),
region_max_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region_name,
        MAX(rep_total_sales) as max_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region_name
),
top_sales_reps AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.region_name,
        rs.sales_rep_name,
        rs.rep_total_sales
    FROM rep_sales rs
    JOIN region_max_sales rms ON rs.region_name = rms.region_name AND rs.rep_total_sales = rms.max_sales
),
region_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region_name,
        COUNT(o.id) as order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as total_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name
)
SELECT 
    rs.region_name,
    rs.order_count,
    rs.total_sales_amount,
    tsr.sales_rep_name,
    tsr.rep_total_sales
FROM region_summary rs
JOIN top_sales_reps tsr ON rs.region_name = tsr.region_name
ORDER BY rs.region_name
